mandate: Complete documentary inventory, explicit inspection coverage, conservative native-image attachment audit, and a frozen feasibility decision. No new image-label association statistic, feature-value scoring, permutation p-value or similarity optimisation is authorized in this phase.
scope: Union of all documentary generic-L loci in pinned ZL3b-n and IT2a-n, retaining source counterparts even if not L, all syntax uncertainty, phantom ! entries, multiword text and unassigned physical panels. This is complete for these files' L coding, not proof of finding every real inscription or every individual drawing in the manuscript. Separately catalogue every major region already described in the atlas; a region is not an individual labelled motif.
units: One documentary locus per row, with separate source records. Ordinary f<number>r/v/panel identifiers map to one physical folio number. fRos maps to an unresolved composite with candidates f85/f86 and one dependence group; it never creates a new independent folio. The whole 85/86 foldout is conservatively a shared dependence group for future feasibility. Multiple scans, faces, panels, crops and alternative readings do not increase physical sample size.
states: Separate documentary_present; atlas_overview_previously_inspected; glyph_zone_previously_inspected; individual_motif_inspected; geometric_attachment_verified_same_exposed_operator; uncertain/unresolved; not_individually_examined; and external_human_review_completed=false. Prior page-level description is never promoted to a verified label-object attachment.
transcription: Keep raw lines, line numbers, syntax and source metadata. No best variant, space repair, phonetic normalization, deletion or semantic guess. Distinguish alternatives, unreadable glyphs, uncertain spaces, multiple apparent words, ligature encoding and non-alphabetic text. Literal recurrence is reported separately by source, across known physical folios and within section/attributed-hand/kind. A documentary matching locus is not a new spatial validation.
preserved_phase25: Reconstruct the exact 35-locus text population and 29 historical admissible motifs without changing phase25 data. Maintain the prior minimums: 6 estimable types, 6 contributing physical folios, 2 strata and 100 possible conditional assignments; the previously required layout-controlled support also needs at least 100 assignments. No threshold is lowered to rescue feasibility. Any later population or feature change needs an explicit new version before measuring association.
scan_audit: Verify local native JPEG bytes and actual pixel dimensions against the atlas inventory for all 213 views. These are available full-size local scans, not newly acquired or necessarily maximum-quality originals. Record original TIFF URLs but do not assume TIFF offers more pixels or recoverability; failed metadata requests remain failures. Assess local crop visibility only when actually displayed. Enlarging display does not restore lost strokes.
native_review_selection: Before new individual image inspection, freeze a deterministic worklist after documentary parsing: all six phase25 exclusions (spatial or fewer than eight features), every additional same-stratum exact-consensus repeated type meeting the same literal criteria outside P/Z/B if any, first three exact-consensus single labels on each P/Z/B physical folio with no phase25 motif inspection, first not-individually-inspected occurrence per documentary kind lacking any phase25 example, and one fRos locus. Deduplicate loci. The ledger states exactly which selected cases were completed or remain pending. Selection uses metadata, transcription and prior coverage only, never shape or association score.
attachment_review: Locate a label and its candidate drawing using documentary order, source context and native pixels. Preserve label and drawing boxes, all alternatives and reasoning. High requires a single defensible connected unit; mere nearest-neighbour position, repeated word identity or desirable sample size cannot settle a tie. No interpretation of word meaning, species, bodily condition or function. New geometry is an exposed-operator review after phase25 results, never external confirmation. A better crop can improve visibility without providing a new physical folio or qualifying eight recoded traits.
feasibility_only: Build a purely combinatorial comparability graph, never image-feature similarities. Count matched same/different-type edges per physical-folio pair, estimable types, strata, contributing folios and the multiset assignment space. Use historical known/unknown masks only for the historical baseline. Report all-text and recovered-geometry scenarios as explicitly optimistic bounds with hypothetical fully observable features, not as real observations or new test results. Include layout/orientation restrictions where documented; unknown bands cannot pass. Preserve unestimable cases and dependencies.
decision_rule: Proceed to a later association experiment only after a fixed eligible spatial inventory and usable feature annotations meet all unchanged structural requirements including the layout requirement. Optimistic bounds may demonstrate impossibility or identify needed work, but cannot alone issue GO. Independent-human status remains separate and false unless a real outside reviewer has supplied sealed data. Freeze the final decision and a prospective next-step protocol before any later measurement; current phase stops at that boundary.
independence: All former page reserves are exposed. Same-operator reinspections, software cross-checks and additional pixels are not independent human validation. The phase25 human packets remain available but no answers are presumed.
preservation: Baseline local commit 89bd7161f7a89c56508d0ba4d3a259a061f00802. Existing phases and atlas are read-only. New versions/evidence go under phase26. No push, publication, deployment or external messaging.
